SETUP.HEADING: PvPLedger Setup
SETUP.DESCRIPTION:
Installs PvPLedger, the AppHelper bridge, optional regional ladder data, and the background sync app.
Use Uninstall Sync to remove the tray app later.
After install: enable the addons in WoW, then /reload when Sync says ladder data updated.
SETUP.RUN_AT_LOGIN: Run PvPLedger Sync at Windows login
SETUP.UNINSTALL_CONFIRM:
Uninstall PvPLedger Sync?

This will:
- Stop the tray app if it is running
- Remove the Windows login startup entry
- Delete the installed sync app from:
  {install_dir}

Your WoW addons and sync settings will be kept.
